children: Dubai, United Arab Emirates, November 24th, 2026, Chainwire
Free iPhone 18 giveaway and 2,500 USDT in Red Packet Airdrops await.
Bybit, the New Financial Platform trusted by more than 90 million users worldwide, has announced the last livestream session for Bybit’s flagship World Series of Trading (WSOT) 2026 live at
2PM UTC
, November 24, 2026.

The WSOT 1V1 AI Assets Battle livestream sets the stage for two traders to go one-on-one in a live trading contest on AI assets in front of a global audience, allowing viewers to watch every move on the traders’ screens. The session also covers the AI market, from adoption and catalysts to valuations and risks.
The livestream agenda touches on the dynamic AI landscape in global markets, including:
The AI Narrative:
adoption versus hype, including catalysts, valuations, and risks
1v1 Trading Battle:
two WSOT traders go one-on-one on AI assets with both screens live
Results and Debrief:
who won, what worked, what did not, and how risk was managed
Live Q&A and Rewards:
audience questions to be answered live, plus reward draws for eligible viewers

WSOT 2026 is set to conclude on December 2, 2026 with over 1,500 squads and individual players vying for up to 10 million USDT in total prizes. The competition recently lowered its volume thresholds for global contestants, cutting the volume requirement for each tier by up to 70% in the Squad Showdown and Individual Showdown, with prize pool sizes unchanged.
Interactive games during the session will award prizes to eligible members of the live audience, with no registration required. In the
Live Question Challenge
, one winner will be randomly selected from the correct answers to receive an iPhone 18. In the
Red Packet Airdrops
, 2,500 USDT in rewards will be dropped at the end of the livestream, with 500 eligible users each receiving a 5 USDT Spot airdrop.
Viewers may tune in on the official page of [WSOT Livestream] 1v1 Trading Battle on AI Assets.
For the full rules and Terms and Conditions of WSOT 2026, users may visit: Bybit WSOT 2026.
